decisions.statement: A field names a key where the page property behind that field says it names one.
A field of a record property is read the same way as a field of the view.
The page type whose keys a view names is the page type that view lists.
A view listing no page type names the keys of no page type.
A key parted by dots names the property its first segment names.
Nothing here judges whether a key is declared, nor rewrites a body.

definition: the fields of a view that name a key, and the page type whose keys those are
